item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Girlhood - Women in Rap (1/4) - Germany (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.12.2021)
item.description:
Yetundey is originally from Leipzig and mixes styles and influences. Layla Boe wants to make the German language smoother in her music.
From 01.12.2021 15:42

item.description:
Since Russia invaded its neighbour, Ukrainian culture has been enjoying a revival. Folklore in particular is a means of resisting the invader by strengthening the country's cultural identity. Tracks East looks at the craze for traditional song and dance as well as the refusal of some artists to express their patriotism through music.
From 14.09.2023 14:12

item.title: Tracks East - Protests, Parties, Death (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.03.2024)
item.description:
With the outcome of the presidential election in mid-March in little doubt, Tracks East meets Russians, at home and in exile, to find out what they are thinking, just a short time after the death of Navalny.

item.title: The Who - One Band's Explosive Story (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.04.2024)
item.description:

This is the story of Pete Townshend (guitar); Roger Daltrey (voice), John Entwistle (bass) and Keith Moon (drums) and the extraordinary creativity they unleashed onto the world of pop.

item.title: #AMINORMAL (1/8) - How to Boost Your Libido (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:

The DSM calls low sex drive in women “female desire disorder”. But given that women often do the lion's share of domestic tasks and childcare on top of their paid work, maybe this is a medical diagnosis... for a.....

item.title: Tracks East - USA-Russia A New Cold War? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.11.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - Russia's war profiteers (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.01.2024)
item.description:

Yet Western products continue to circulate in Russia, where the black market is flourishing. Many are getting rich out of this illicit trade in illegal goods.

item.title: #AMINORMAL (2/8) - Managing a Long Distance Relationship (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:
Is it possible to have an addiction to the internet when most daily tasks require the Internet? That's especially true for couples who've only ever met online and depend on technology to keep the relationship going. For them, spending more than 7 hours a day on their phone is normal. But the DSM would describe them as addicts.

item.description:

item.title: Tracks East - Iranian Women Resist (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.09.2023)
item.description:

item.title: #AMINORMAL (6/8) - How to Live With a Hoarder (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:
Enthusiasts present their collections of stones, Star Wars, dolls, axes and even bones… and their spouses are supposed to just make room! They thought they were normal, except if they were read the diagnosis of the DSM, the bible of mental health, they might recognise themselves. The mania for excessively accumulating objects is qualified as a disorder!

item.title: NFT: What the Punk! - Far West (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.06.2024)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:
Tracks East finds out how militarisation, migration, and an increasing polarisation within society are affecting the mood in Poland as elections approach.

item.description:

Contributions from Iggy Pop, Bobby Gillespie of Primal Scream and Joy Division’s Stephen Morris.

item.title: Tracks East - Food: A Weapon of War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.09.2023)
item.description:

Tracks East witnesses an artistic performance that revives the trauma of the great famine that decimated Ukraine in the 1930s. item.title: Tracks East - Pop, Power and Propaganda (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.09.2023)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Influencers in MMA (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.12.2023)

item.title: Argentina and Chile - The North - The Magic Andes (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.05.2024)
item.description:

But one day Erna discovers that she has Jewish ancestry and with the rise of the Nazis, their very lives are in peril.Through hundreds of letters and private family footage, the story of one German family is brought to life.

item.description:

item.description:
From the instrumentalisation of historical narratives to the re-appropriation of national history, the war in Ukraine is also a war of histories. The conflict between two radically opposing visions goes back several centuries. item.title: Mafia and Banks (3/3) - Crime without Limits (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.01.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Crazy Borders - Llivia, Between France and Spain (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.07.2022)
item.description:

item.title: The First Year - A film by Patricio Guzmán (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.01.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Triads: The Chinese Mafia on the Rise (2/3) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.01.2024)
item.description:

item.description:
In the 1980s, Ronald Reagan and the republicans pushed through policies of deregulation and tax cuts whilst Silicon Valley became the new Eldorado for young companies such as Apple and Microsoft. item.description:

item.description:
The Federal Constitutional Court was founded 70 years ago. It is one of the most powerful institutions in Germany, along with the federal government, parliament and the Federal President. Often hostile to politics and respected by Germans, it has shaped the Federal Republic. But do these judges have too much power given they don't have a democratic mandate?

item.title: Marie Laguerre, Street Harassment Hero - Domino Effect (2/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
Maire Laguerre was walking home from work when she was sexually harassed by a man in the street. When she told her aggressor to get lost, he threw an ashtray at her and punched her in the face. She decided to post the video of her attack online and it went viral, eventually triggering a change in street harassment laws in France.
From 24.08.2021 20:19

item.description:

item.title: The Battle of Chile (1/3) - The Insurrection of the Bourgeoisie (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.09.2023)
item.description:
Chilean president Salvador Allende wanted to modernise his country and fight poverty. item.description:

item.description:

item.title: How the Germans Learned to Love France (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.05.2024)

item.description:

item.description:
The parasol or beach umbrella is synonymous with summer beach holidays but it has not always been so. Historian Elsa Devienne tells us the social and cultural history of an object that has appeared on and disappeared from our beaches as fashion, tanning practices and our attitudes to our bodies change.

item.title: The Lottery Ball and the Politics of Chance - Making History (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.09.2021)

item.title: The Mantle of Roger II of Sicily - Making History (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.09.2021)

item.title: Making History - Coal: The Poisonous Black Diamond (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.03.2022)
item.description:

item.title: Duels of History - Marie Curie vs Jeanne Langevin (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.11.2023)
